title: Moving a booking to a time that overlaps its old time is allowed

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: rescheduleBooking places the new booking before cancelling the old, and validateAndPlaceBooking counts the old row as a booked range, so moving a 60 minute session 30 minutes later fails with 'too close to another booking'. Fix: drop the row named by rescheduledFrom from the conflict ranges (the unique-start guard still holds).

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
